summary: Iteration 14 (Dhara / MSafe Legal Aid) — end-to-end verification of the 4 user-selected features: (1) Salary-not-paid labour retrieval, (2) On-device Notice Drafts + POST /api/drafts/consume paywall, (3) Free Fraud Checklist screen with timer + AsyncStorage persistence, (4) 3 new state rent entries (TG/WB/KL). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed serially against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Labour retrieval returns the expected chips — Wage Code 45 for 'employer hasn't paid my salary… where do I complain?', IR Code 70 for 'fired without notice', SS Code 53 for 'gratuity after 5 years', Wage Code 18 for 'salary deducted illegally'. State rent — after PATCH /api/auth/state to TG/WB/KL, the same rent-arrears question returns 'Telangana Rent Control 10' / 'WB Premises Tenancy 6-7' / 'Kerala Rent Control 11' respectively, and each citation payload carries state + text_kind. /api/drafts/consume enforces quota — unknown draft_type → 400, no token → 401, first call → 200 with drafts_used/drafts_remaining, second non-Pro call → 402 with detail.reason='drafts_exhausted'. Citation-integrity guard holds — LLM reply text contains no 'Section', 'Article', act names or section numbers for any of the labour/rent/regression queries (draft template body legitimately contains 'SECTION 138' as documented in the review request). Regression — cheque bounce → NI 138 only, UPI fraud → IT/1930/RBI cyber chips, helmet fine → MV 194D, 'rights when arrested' → Article 22 chip, /api/reference/states → 36 entries, bookmarks PUT/GET/DELETE round-trip. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390×844): logged in as protest@gandhikar.in, Settings shows the new 'Tools' section with rows testID open-drafts and open-fraud-checklist. Drafts list (testID drafts-screen) shows the quota card ('1 free notice left · unlimited with Pro') and all 3 cards (cheque_bounce / deposit_refund / unpaid_salary) with deadlines. Tapping draft-cheque_bounce opened draft-form-screen, filling field-sender_name / field-amount / field-cheque_no and tapping draft-generate produced draft-output — the deterministic template with the 30-day + 15-day cheque-bounce wording (verified at src/drafts.ts:47 and :94), and draft-copy worked. After the first generate the quota flipped to 'Free notice used · upgrade to Pro' and the second attempt returned HTTP 402 → the web confirm() dialog appeared with message 'Your 1 free notice draft has been used. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited ready-to-send legal notices. Open upgrade?' ✓. Fraud checklist (testID fraud-checklist-screen) rendered 7 steps, ticking testID fraud-step-call1930 flipped fraud-timer to 'Time since you started 00:01 · 1 / 7 done', a full page reload preserved progress ('00:04 · 1 / 7 done' — AsyncStorage works on web too), and testID fraud-reset cleared it back to '--:-- 0 / 7 done'. drafts_used was reset to 0 for both test users at the end of the run. NOTE: I did not exercise the chat next-step-<msgId> gold chip UI end-to-end (it requires a fresh chat + streamed reply through the LLM); however, retrieval + citations are proven correct by the backend suite so the chip's data source is sound — flagging as retest_needed=false but adding a soft action item for main agent to eyeball it.

react_native_issues.issue: Tapping testID fraud-back with no navigation history logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator.' when the screen is opened as a deep link. Not user-visible in normal flow (Settings → fraud-checklist has history) but flag it in case of deep-link entry. Reference: /app/frontend/app/fraud-checklist.tsx:135.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Main agent to eyeball the chat gold next-step chip (testID next-step-<msgId>) after sending 'My cheque bounced, what is the deadline for the notice?' — automated run didn't reach that screen after the fraud-checklist test. Retrieval side is proven (NI 138 chip returns correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:936-973 /api/drafts/consume — non-Pro users only get drafts_used incremented on success, Pro users' counter is frozen, and the 402 paywall payload includes reason='drafts_exhausted' + price labels matching the credentials file. Emits a draft_events audit doc per generation. Clean.
server.py:169-171 /api/auth/me exposes drafts_used / drafts_free_limit / drafts_remaining computed off DRAFTS_FREE — matches the frontend contract in drafts/index.tsx line 13.

corpus_labour.py — every labour entry has a require_any guard rooted in _WORK_GUARD so 'notice', 'pay', 'gratuity' can't drag a labour chip into an unrelated answer. Verified: rent questions with state=TG/WB/KL still return only the state rent chip, no labour chip leaks in. samadhan pathway sits behind require_any including 'where' — a bare 'complain about landlord' won't trigger it.

corpus_state.py — TG/WB/KL rent entries use the same require_any as DL/MH/KA (all tenancy tokens). state field + text_kind='official_summary' both present. state hits stream as regular 'citation' frames (server.py:786) so the FE renders them alongside central chips.

src/drafts.ts:47 & :94 — cheque-bounce template contains both '30 DAYS' and '15 days' wording exactly as the review request required. Draft body legitimately references 'SECTION 138' which the review whitelists.

fraud-checklist.tsx uses AsyncStorage for progress and its behaviour is verified on web reload — good defensive fallback. fraud-back router.back() emits a harmless GO_BACK warning on deep-link entry (fixable with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/settings')` if wanted).

src/drafts.ts is on-device deterministic (no LLM) — matches the iteration 14 spec, costs nothing per draft. Fields are typed and blank fields render blank lines for handwritten completion (comment at line 145 in [type].tsx).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the flows that were exercised (Settings Tools rows, Drafts list, Draft form fill + generate + copy, 402 paywall dialog, Fraud checklist 7 steps + tick + reload persistence + reset). Chat next-step chip UI itself not clicked end-to-end this run — retrieval side proven by backend suite.

seed_data_creation: Set state=TG / WB / KL / DL on protest@gandhikar.in via /api/auth/state to run the 3 new state rent citations, restored to DL at the end. drafts_used was consumed 1× per user during testing and reset back to 0 for both protest@gandhikar.in and testuser@gandhikar.in via a direct db.users.updateMany at the end so the file is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration_14_labour_rent_drafts.py -n 0 --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_14.xml`. The test file reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env directly when the env var isn't exported, so it works in a fresh shell. The SSE chat endpoint is /api/chat/stream and emits citations as individual 'citation' frames (one per chip), not a single 'citations' array — the collector in the test handles both. TestDraftsQuota is idempotent: it accepts either (200 then 402) or (402 already) depending on drafts_used state, and it does NOT reset the DB itself. If a subsequent run needs a clean quota, run `mongosh gandhikar_db --eval 'db.users.updateMany({email: {\$in:["protest@gandhikar.in","testuser@gandhikar.in"]}}, {\$set:{drafts_used:0}})'`. To reach the login screen on the web preview you must first tap Continue on the language screen — the sign-in form testIDs are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT login-email / login-password / login-submit).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found this iteration — the fraud-back GO_BACK warning is a benign navigator log, not a user-visible defect.
